questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which one of the following has a square planar geometry?
questions.explanation: Complexes with <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.439ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="4.37ex" height="2.326ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -833.9 1931.6 1027.9" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D451" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D451"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(523,0)"><use data-c="1D460" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D460"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(992,0)"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D45D" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D45D"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(536,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="32" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"></use></g></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> hybridisation are square planar. So <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.566ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10.899ex" height="2.71ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -948 4817.2 1198" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mspace"></g><g data-mml-node="mspace" transform="translate(167,0)"></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(334,0)"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mrow"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="5B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-5B"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(278,0)"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D443" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D443"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(751,0)"><use data-c="1D461" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D461"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(1112,0)"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(1872,0)"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D459" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D459"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(331,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="34" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-34"></use></g></g></g></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(2884.6,0)"><use data-c="5D" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-5D"></use></g></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" transform="translate(3195.6,477.1) scale(0.707)" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="32" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(500,0)"><use data-c="2212" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2212"></use></g></g></g></g><g data-mml-node="mspace" transform="translate(4483.2,0)"></g><g data-mml-node="mspace" transform="translate(4650.2,0)"></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> is square planar in shape.
